name: Inverted‑V Dipole
description: The Inverted‑V Dipole is a variation of the half‑wave dipole where the legs slope downward from a central apex. It reduces required horizontal space, lowers feed impedance, and provides a broad, forgiving bandwidth.
modelingNotes: Leg angle strongly influences feed impedance.
Apex height determines takeoff angle and pattern shape.
End effects shorten the required physical length.
Lower leg angles increase bandwidth but reduce gain.
Radiation pattern becomes more omnidirectional as legs slope downward.
Wire diameter affects Q factor and tuning sensitivity.
